description: Configuration file for Vercel's serve static file server (serve.json)

cleanUrls.description: Serve .html files without the extension, and redirect requests that include it. Use an array of glob patterns to limit this to matching paths.

directoryListing.description: Show a directory listing when a directory has no index file. Use an array of glob patterns to limit listings to matching paths.

etag.description: Send an ETag header calculated from the file contents instead of a Last-Modified header.

headers.description: Custom response headers for paths matching a source pattern.

source.description: Glob pattern matched against the request path.

public.description: Directory to serve, relative to the configuration file. Defaults to the current working directory.

destination.description: Target URL or path. Supports path segment placeholders from the source.

source.description: Path pattern to match. Supports glob and path-to-regexp placeholders.

type.description: HTTP status code of the redirect. Defaults to 301.

renderSingle.description: Serve a lone file in the directory at the root path instead of a directory listing.

rewrites.description: Rewrite matching request paths to another path without changing the URL.

destination.description: Path to serve instead. Supports path segment placeholders from the source.

source.description: Path pattern to match. Supports glob and path-to-regexp placeholders.

symlinks.description: Resolve symlinks and serve the target file instead of returning a 404.

trailingSlash.description: Force (true) or remove (false) a trailing slash on request paths. Unset leaves paths as requested.

unlisted.description: Glob patterns of paths to hide from directory listings.

title: serve.json
